name: agent-wars
description: Grand strategy wargame with LLM opponents — Milestone 0.1 Hello Hex World

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.js && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.js win && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.js linux && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --linux
scripts.dist:mac: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') { console.error('Build for macOS is supported only on macOS. Run npm run dist:mac on a Mac. See .spec/packaging.md'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.js mac && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac
